sections.title: Service intelligence
sections.intro: National aggregate service research, not individual facility service availability, installed assets or purchasing intent. Source-specific observations are not additional providers. Individual service evidence is not published in this workspace.

groups.title: Surgical and dialysis capability evidence
groups.note: Q3 2026 iQIES. Counts are field observations within ASC and ESRD source scopes. A dash means the state is not present in the qualified field distribution; it is not a reported zero. Count fields report the number of source rows with numeric values, not the sum of rooms or stations.

groups.title: Hospital service provision codes
groups.note: Q3 2026 QIES, hospital category 01. Historical 2023 reference layout remains provisional for this release. Codes are presented literally without interpreting provision mode, current availability or installation.

groups.title: ASC service provision arrangements
groups.note: Q3 2026 iQIES, 8,492 ASC source records per field. Codes are matched exactly to the publisher's M5/M7 ASC domains. Outside-source provision is a reported delivery mode, not a named contract, installed equipment or buying intent.

groups.title: Home health reported services
groups.note: October 21, 2026 Care Compare release. Yes and No are literal source values; other or missing values are not treated as No. Reported service flags do not establish a physical site capability or current availability.

groups.title: Long-term care hospital total beds
groups.note: September 23, 2026 Care Compare release. Total reported beds are not certified nursing beds or occupied beds. Six records do not report a qualified whole-number value and remain unknown.

groups.title: Hospital enrollment subgroup classifications
groups.note: November 2026 hospital enrollment release, 9,120 rows. The publisher's 13 independent flags all matched the Y/N domain. Categories overlap; not unique facilities, operational capacity or installed equipment.

groups.title: Hospital service provision — matched research subset
groups.note: Q3 2026 QIES category 01, 5,362 source rows with program code 00 and exact CCN/state candidate in November Care Compare. Historical 2023 code labels remain provisional. Staff, arrangement, both and not provided are separate reported modes; blank is unknown. Not current operation, confirmed contracts or installed assets.

groups.title: Hospital infrastructure and affiliation count coverage
groups.note: Same 5,362-record research subset; cells count source records with positive, explicit zero or other/missing numeric values, not beds, rooms, sites or FTE totals. Historical field meanings remain provisional. Counts can overlap; unresolved operating-room count and unreviewed staffing sums excluded.

sections.title: Compliance research
sections.intro: Historical national aggregates. Citation rows are not inspection events, open violations or service leads. Research contexts are not equipment failures; correction wording and date validity are separate evidence dimensions.

groups.title: Citation source domains
groups.note: All 619,069 source rows reconcile across the three domains; source release 2026-10-28.

groups.title: Service research contexts
groups.note: Exact source-category research context; no facility-specific vulnerability or purchasing inference. Reuse review remains pending for additional projections.

groups.title: Dictionary and date quality
groups.note: Exact text matching does not prove historical tag version or present correction status. Initial unmapped statuses are distinct from later literal wording comparisons.

groups.title: Literal correction wording
groups.note: Literal source wording comparison only. Candidate no-plan wording and unresolved other are not active violation counts.

groups.title: Nursing inspection and dispute flags
groups.note: October 28, 2026 source snapshot. Independent source-reported flags may overlap; counts are historical citation rows, not unique inspections, dispute outcomes or currently outstanding violations. All flags matched the Y/N domain. The health file has no tag-version column.

groups.title: Nursing-home source-reported oversight indicators
groups.note: October 28, 2026 snapshot. Abuse and inspection-age flags use the publisher's historical survey definitions; not current incidents, outstanding violations, property title or present-day risk scores.

groups.title: Nursing-home Special Focus source status
groups.note: October 28, 2026 snapshot. Program and candidate status differ from individual citations. Blank means no listed status in the source, not a compliance determination.

sections.title: Equipment & environmental research
sections.intro: Source qualification and candidate evidence only. Individual mammography and water system records are not published here. No confirmed installed equipment, water-system connection, current compliance or sales opportunity is inferred.

groups.title: FDA mammography directory
groups.note: Separately qualified ephemeral directory; not included in the 19-source integrated baseline. No stable publisher ID, certificate dates, unit counts or inspection findings. Six pinned address-width exceptions were retained without truncation; reuse review pending.

groups.title: EPA drinking-water source qualification
groups.note: Strict identifier gate blocked; no EPA records retained in the integrated database. Unresolved keys must not be linked.

groups.title: Medical service-area candidate evidence
groups.note: Exact institutional name and reported state only, not a physical-site or water-service connection. No individual candidates published; reuse review pending.
rows: Distinct CMS provider source rows in pairs

groups.title: Nursing-home reported sprinkler coverage
groups.note: October 28, 2026 provider release. Source-reported coverage of required areas, not an engineering survey or current fire-code compliance determination. Partial and unavailable are separate. No means an observed source category, not a count of uninspected buildings.

sections.title: Data intelligence
sections.intro: Historical qualification evidence is distinct from currently published public projections. No full national database is attached to GitHub Pages. Data quality and availability are not regulatory compliance.

groups.title: National integration and identity evidence
groups.note: 19-source logical recovery; source-scoped CCN, state and type candidates are not unique physical sites. Address agreement is corroboration only.

groups.title: iQIES termination date evidence
groups.note: Only unambiguous dates normalized under pinned source audit. Ambiguity and unavailable dates preserved; no current operating status inferred.

groups.title: Snapshot retention checkpoint
groups.note: This is the historical artifact checkpoint, not an assertion of current availability. The artifact contains only the nine Care Compare sources. No verified durable private storage or full national backup.

groups.title: Home health general control classification
groups.note: Publisher defines this as the agency's control type, not a legal property owner. Other/missing tokens remain unclassified. National aggregate only; individual ownership fields are not published.

groups.title: National field audit coverage
groups.note: 19 pinned source releases profiled; restricted contact and narrative fields assessed for presence only. These are original source columns, not validated application features. Historical definitions and unresolved codes remain subject to review.

groups.title: CLIA certificate code distribution
groups.note: Q3 2026 laboratory registry records. All five certificate codes match the catalog-linked April 2023 layout; meanings remain historical-reference labels, not a count of active laboratories. No facility-level records or certificate status inference.

groups.title: Hospital-to-laboratory reference evidence
groups.note: Exact source CLIA-reference tokens matched to laboratory registry identifiers; 25 candidate pairs disagree on reported state. Historical hospital category and registry records are source-scoped, not unique physical facilities, verified affiliations, current operations or installed assets.

groups.title: Reported nursing-home chain membership
groups.note: October 2026 Care Compare. CMS group IDs represent reported affiliation through ownership, officer or managerial relationships, not a resolved legal parent or property owner. Group size is reconciled once per group; names and identifiers are not published.
rows: Records with a valid chain ID

groups.title: Nursing cross-source group corroboration
groups.note: October Care Compare versus November SNF PECOS enrollment. Exact CCN/state pairs only. Group identifiers are compared as literal tokens in separate release namespaces; agreement does not establish a legal entity, and conflicts or missing fields must remain unresolved.

groups.title: Reported PECOS organizational relationship classes
groups.note: November 2026 organization-only source rows. Codes are mapped using the applicable July publisher dictionary; all observed code/text pairs agree. Role records are not unique organizations or sites. Direct, indirect, management and financial relationships must remain distinct; dash means not applicable in this source.

groups.title: Organization classification agreement and conflicts
groups.note: Distinct valid organization PAC tokens within each source family, not role rows. Yes means at least one affirmative report. Conflict means both Y and N for the same PAC in that source. Flags can overlap and do not establish legal property ownership or a verified vendor relationship.

groups.title: Reported ownership-change types
groups.note: Q3 2026 source release containing historical changes since 2016. Current July and documented earlier CH wording were reconciled in the targeted qualification. Counts are source rows, not unique transactions or title transfers. Ambiguous dates have not been coerced.

groups.title: Hospital registry and directory comparison
groups.note: Q3 2026 QIES compared to November 12, 2026 Care Compare hospital directory. Exact identifier and state candidates are not unique physical sites; literal address/city/ZIP agreement is corroboration only. Code 00 is historical program status, not current operation.

groups.title: CLIA historical termination-code scopes
groups.note: Q3 2026 source records; historical reference semantics only. Both raw termination columns agree row by row in this release. Code 00 is not proof of current operations or a valid certificate. Code 95 has no established authoritative meaning.

groups.title: CLIA certificates by reported status scope
groups.note: Five historical certificate classifications, stratified by literal source status. Counts are records, not independently confirmed current licenses or unique physical premises.

groups.title: CLIA reported facility-type classifications
groups.note: Q3 2026 category-specific facility-type codes using historical reference labels. Laboratory records may occur within other provider types; no unique-site, property, or current operations inference. The extracted code 18 label is incomplete.

groups.title: CLIA accreditation declarations and confirmations
groups.note: Historical application X flags, literal Y confirmation flags, and match-date presence. Organization labels follow the source field prefixes; organizations can overlap. These are not verified current accreditations.

groups.title: CLIA certificate date diagnostics
groups.note: Literal YYYYMMDD calendar dates compared with the source period end (September 30, 2026), not today's date. The combined termination/expiration date does not identify which event occurred; no present-day certificate validity inference.

groups.title: CLIA identifier and affiliation-reference diagnostics
groups.note: Exact identifier tokens and source flag/count observations only. Affiliation matches are candidates, not validated relationships, ownership, or physical sites. Date and multisite discrepancies are review flags, not proof of errors.

groups.title: Hospital reported type and ownership classifications
groups.note: November 12, 2026 release. Nine type labels and 12 ownership labels independently reconcile to 5,435 records. Two separate classification dimensions; no property title or legal owner inference.

groups.title: Hospital clinical quality measure availability
groups.note: November 12, 2026 provider release. Count of records with numeric measure-count fields, not patient counts, violations or clinical performance. Missing measures are not zero; groups may overlap.
